title: The Climate Alarm Clock

description: The Climate Alarm Clock is Ireland's climate news podcast. also featuring science and policy explainers, interviews with experts and campaigners, emotional support and a bit of craic If you would like to donate money to support the upkeep of the Pod; https://www.buymeacoffee.com/theclimatealarm And here is a plethora of other ways to keep up to date and get in touch: climatealarmclock@gmail.com https://twitter.com/theclimatealarm https://www.facebook.com/climatealarmclock/ https://www.instagram.com/climatealarmclock/ https://mastodon.ie/@theclimatealarm
